question: Where must the balika element be placed within the peak’s divisions?
premises: The context is the peak structure.
The balika-place is the element being located.
Its position is specified in the elemental part at the crest-rise.
inference: The balika element is to be placed in the elemental part at the rise of the crest on the peak.
plain_english: On the peak, the place of the balika should be set in the elemental part at the rise of the crest.
